body.name: Balanced restricted difference in means
body.construction: Given \(S_{\ell}\) of size \(K_{\ell}\), draw \(T_{\ell}\) uniformly among its \(t(K_{\ell})\)-subsets, put \(U_{\ell}=S_{\ell}\setminus T_{\ell}\), assign exposure \(\mathbf 1_{D_i}\) to every \(i\in T_{\ell}\) and \(\mathbf 0_{D_i}\) to every \(i\in U_{\ell}\), and compute \(\widehat\tau_{\ell}=e_{\ell}^{\mathsf T}\theta\).
